title: Restructure and TypeScript
detail: packages/ and lab/ layout, npm workspaces, Node type stripping, type check.

title: CI, license and decisions
detail: SHA-pinned CI, generated-files check, Apache-2.0, ADRs 001–006.

title: Novelty matrix
detail: Position against Alipay-PIBench, the Stripe agent benchmark and BaxBench.

title: Reference checkout
detail: Local checkout on node:sqlite with a transactional fulfillment outbox, fake provider, 19 checks, 7 seeded defects; retry and restart recovery tested.

title: SubjectAdapter and check registry
detail: Checks work against any subject; each check versioned with control, layer and oracle.

title: Evidence records
detail: Evidence schema v1 with commit, versions, timestamps and redaction policy.

title: Checks for remaining controls
detail: 11 of 12 controls have checks (30 checks, 17 seeded defects). Browser integrity waits for the browser harness.

title: Harm oracle
detail: 12 end-to-end scenarios read the provider ledger and fulfillment records for underpayment, double fulfillment, cross-account, lost order and inconsistent refund. Never feeds the score. Not yet shown in the portal.

title: Mutation-based defects
detail: Automatically mutated variants replace hand-seeded ones for measuring detection.

title: Metric v1 decisions
detail: Idempotency criticality, observation-layer profiles, profile-first reporting.

title: Docker sandbox stack
detail: One fresh compose stack per run: sandbox + Postgres, MCP tool server, agent runner. Sandbox has no egress; runner reaches only model API hosts.

title: Django ledger service
detail: Double-entry ledger (immutable entries, cached balances under row locks, drift check), payment intents state machine, refunds, payouts, idempotency keys, admin console; Hypothesis property tests and concurrency tests.

title: Fault layer and control API
detail: Per-run faults: timeout after commit, delayed visibility, partial success, stale conflict, duplicate delivery. Test-control API to reset, seed and read the ledger.

title: Synthetic world and task generator
detail: Seeded, versioned worlds (merchants, customers, accounts, payees, invoices, history) and tasks with expected ledger end states; a scripted solver proves each is reachable.

title: Reproduce Faghih et al.
detail: Run the public code for Tool Preferences in Agentic LLMs are Unreliable (EMNLP 2025) and reproduce one result.

title: MCP tool server and design levels
detail: Payment tools at four design levels: no idempotency, optional key, required key, server-side dedupe with status lookup and an explicit outcome-unknown error.

title: Agent runner and agent harm oracle
detail: LangChain/LangGraph runner across models with fixed settings, explicit retries, k repeats and a spend cap. Oracle compares the ledger with the expected end state: duplicate payment, wrong amount, wrong payee, unauthorized action, lost payment, false report.

title: Evidence schema 1.2 for agent runs
detail: Own ADR: model ID and date, prompts, tool-manifest hash, design level, fault schedule, seed, redacted transcript.

title: B1 pilot and lab outreach
detail: Small grid with k = 5, results with intervals and spend recorded; short note shared with the Faghih et al. authors.

title: B1 failure study
detail: Design level × fault type × fault rate × model, three or more models; tasks and oracle frozen first.

title: B2 tool-preference manipulation
detail: Competing money-moving tools with edited descriptions; defenses: pinned tool registry, deterministic payee/amount policy, confirm-before-send.

title: Agent analysis and write-up
detail: pass^k and harm rates with cluster bootstrap by task; workshop-length paper; agent runs in the portal.

title: Stripe emulator
detail: Stripe-Signature scheme and event shapes, conformance-tested on recorded sandbox events.

title: Square emulator
detail: Square HMAC over notification URL + body, conformance-tested on recorded sandbox events.

title: Sandbox mode and scope gate
detail: Real sandbox payments; refuses non-allowlisted targets and live-mode keys.

title: Container isolation
detail: Track A subjects run in the Docker setup built for the agent sandbox: one sealed, disposable stack per subject, driven from outside through SubjectAdapter; no real keys or card data inside.

title: Architecture variants
detail: Owned checkout variants across provider, hosted or embedded checkout, fulfillment trigger and security layers on or off. Optionally a Django checkout through an HTTP SubjectAdapter.

title: Open-source shops
detail: 1–2 platforms in containers with our sandbox accounts, plus adapters.

title: Run ingest and viewer
detail: Local and CI runs from both tracks send evidence records to the portal, which stores them and shows what each run did; agent runs show tool calls and the ledger diff.

title: Pilot and preregistration
detail: Small variant matrix end to end; harm scenarios frozen; reviewer recruited; OSF preregistration.

title: Architecture sweep
detail: Checks and harm oracle across the full variant matrix and the open-source shops; exclusions accounted for.

title: Agent literature review
detail: Structured review of published work on agent-built payment integrations, mapped onto the layers the sweep measured.

title: Analysis and adjudication
detail: Blind adjudication; Python analysis for RQ1–RQ7; integration guidance for developers and their coding agents, and API-design guidance for agent-facing payment tools.

title: Coordinated disclosure
detail: Private reports to maintainers for any open-source findings.

title: Preprint
detail: Track A paper with reproducibility appendix (the Track B write-up is milestone 38).

title: Dataset and public site
detail: Variants, synthetic worlds and tasks, evidence records from both tracks, results and method, published after disclosure review.

title: Open-source testing tool
detail: End-to-end payment testing for developers' own apps in sealed environments, no real card data; scope gate built in. Starts as CLI v0.1.

title: Browser harness
detail: Playwright flows for browser-layer controls and the browser-only profile. Parked by ADR 011: RQ3 waits until Track A is under way.
